name: 33460 · Lake Worth, FL
findings: ZIP 33460 (Lake Worth) has 103 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33460 (Lake Worth) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
53% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
